eyebrow: Enterprise Cloud Architecture & Advanced Capstone · Chapter 3
subtitle: Lesson 10 · Network Architecture at Enterprise Scale

steps.label: Dedicated circuit: never touches the public internet
steps.sub: ExpressRoute or Direct Connect, provisioned through a connectivity provider

steps.label: VPN: IPsec-encrypted tunnel over the public internet
steps.sub: stood up in hours, with a lower throughput ceiling

steps.label: Different failure modes, SLAs, and lead times
steps.sub: not just a cheap vs. expensive version of the same thing

code:
az network express-route create \
  --resource-group hub-rg \
  --name primary-circuit \
  --provider "Equinix" \
  --peering-location "Washington DC" \
  --bandwidth 1000 \
  --sku-family MeteredData \
  --sku-tier Standard

az network express-route gateway connection create \
  --resource-group hub-rg \
  --gateway-name hub-er-gateway \
  --name er-connection \
  --circuit-name primary-circuit
caption: Bandwidth, SKU, and peering location are a conversation with a connectivity provider before Azure config starts.

eyebrow: AWS Direct Connect: connection + private VIF
code:
aws directconnect create-connection \
  --location "EqDC2" \
  --bandwidth "1Gbps" \
  --connection-name "primary-dx-connection"

aws directconnect create-private-virtual-interface \
  --connection-id dxcon-fguhmqlc \
  --new-private-virtual-interface '{
    "virtualInterfaceName": "prod-vif",
    "vlan": 101,
    "asn": 65000,
    "directConnectGatewayId": "abcd1234-ab12-cd34-ef56-abcdef123456"
  }'
caption: A Direct Connect Gateway lets one physical connection serve multiple VPCs instead of one per VPC.

steps.label: High, sustained, predictable throughput: dedicated circuit
steps.sub: a replicating data warehouse, a trading floor, a large migration

steps.label: Branch office or fast-turnaround site: VPN
steps.sub: lower cost, no peering-location dependency, live in hours

steps.label: Can't tolerate an outage: both, VPN as automatic failover
steps.sub: resilience comes from two independent paths, not one strong path
